subject: Agriculture
hook: AGRICULTURE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Only about 1% of farms—those larger than 50 hectares—own more than 70% of the world’s agricultural land
angle_support: "While only 1% of all farms globally are greater than 50 hectares (120 acres), they encompass more than 70% of the world's farmland."
"Five of every six farms in the world consist of fewer than 2 hectares (4.9 acres) and take up only around 12% of all agricultural land."
title: 1% of farms own 70% of the world's farmland
description: A tiny minority of massive farms control most of the planet's agricultural land, while the overwhelming majority of farms are tiny and hold little acreage. The numbers reveal a stark concentration of land ownership.
narration: AGRICULTURE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You assume most farms are small family plots that together dominate the land. In reality, the tiny fraction of huge farms control the majority of acreage in the modern era. Only 1 % of farms worldwide exceed 50 hectares, yet they hold more than 70 % of all agricultural land, while five‑sixths of farms are under 2 hectares and cover just 12 % of the land, making them the dominant force in global food production. Big farms shape the world, not the tiny family fields today.
